Mc.bar_b_note: A's larger type is readable, but neither panel has the teal interaction accent, gold progression or controller face-button glyphs that make Palworld's HUD read at a glance.

Kh.bar_b_note: A murky, near-black walled box with almost no sky, no warm Meadows grass or blue distance, and no lit tall keep sank it; the day frames look like night.

My.bar_b_note: B's standing wolf matches the Tanglevolt bar, but its faint poses hover above the floor (and A's emissive overlay floods the fur and its faint-end pose twists unreadably), which no shipping game would show.

Yx.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised elder with readable eyes and a Meadows-green palette carried it; only the softer, slightly plastic material finish keeps it below top-tier.

Oy.bar_b_note: Good sky and warm grass help, but an even grass carpet, one repeated sapling at regular spacing, flat midday light without shafts or haze, and an empty middle distance keep it short of Palworld's lived-in density.

Qn.bar_b_note: B's rounded ironwood crown is a real landmark, but the uniform grass carpet, cloned saplings and flat light without atmospheric depth still read as a sparse prototype next to Palworld.

Eu.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, brace, cap and stone footing read as built, but it is still a lone thin flat panel beside a pale faceted placeholder boulder, below Palworld's base-building finish.

top_changes.change: Relight and open up the Kh stronghold approach: raise exposure and sky visibility, add warm lit torches/windows on a tall keep, and replace the flat wall-hung banners with pole-mounted draped war banners.

Break up the Meadows grove (Oy/Qn) into authored groves, edges and clearings: vary sapling species and scale, cluster them, thin the grass carpet near paths, and add distance haze and light shafts for depth.
Fix creature faint poses so the body lies on the floor (B floats; A twists), and tone A's emissive lightning overlay back to thin veins so the fur reads like the Tanglevolt bar.
